# Smit Sir Commerce

Smit Sir Commerce is a Commerce education brand serving Class 11 and Class 12 students in Mehsana, Gujarat, India, with online learning support also available.

## Primary entity
- Name: Smit Sir Commerce
- Alternate public name: Smit Sir Commerce Classes
- Educator: Smit Thaker
- Website: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/
- Primary local page: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/commerce-coaching-mehsana
- Area served: Mehsana, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 63537 09585
- Email: infosmitsircommerce@gmail.com

## Subjects and services
- Class 11 Commerce tuition
- Class 12 Commerce tuition
- Economics
- Business Studies
- Accountancy
- Entrepreneurship
- Physical Education
- Chapter-wise Commerce notes and revision resources
- Free interactive Economics and Accountancy calculators
- Practice tests and exam-oriented preparation
- Free test-paper analysis
- Demo-class booking

Main tools hub: https://www.smitsircommerce.in/tools

Economics calculators include:

Accountancy calculators include current ratio, quick ratio, debt-equity ratio, proprietary ratio, inventory turnover, trade receivables turnover, working capital turnover, net profit ratio, operating ratio and return on investment tools under the /tools/ section.
